tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.take: Denver rides a four-game win streak into Charlotte, and the matchup sets up for points: Carolina's secondary is missing its top four cornerbacks, while Denver's safeties are banged up — Brandon Jones is out and Talanoa Hufanga is questionable — so both offenses can move it. Two board plays here: the Over 44.5 at +2.0% EV and Denver on the moneyline at +1.2%. The lean is Denver laying less than a field goal, with the Over as the better number.
games.title: Broncos at Panthers: both secondaries short-handed
games.venue: Bank of America Stadium, Charlotte, NC
games.verdict: LEAN: DEN -2.5 — and the Over 44.5 is on the board at +2.0% EV.
games.weather: No NWS watch or warning in Charlotte; no weather factor expected

games.take: The highest total on the early slate, and the market has this one priced about right — no US price clears our 0.75% bar (the best number anywhere is an offshore Colts +5.5, not a board play), so this is a lean, not a board play. No true edge here, but the lean is Dallas: the better roster, laying less than five, in a game expected to clear 50 points.
games.title: Cowboys at Colts: the shootout window
games.verdict: LEAN: DAL -4.5 — no true edge at -225, but the lean is Dallas in a high-total game.

games.take: The lowest total on the slate, and the rare sight of the Eagles as home underdogs in a divisional game. The market has the Giants as the rightful favorite, but the number on Philadelphia is a touch too long: Eagles +3 clears our bar at +1.6% EV and is on the board. The lean is the home dog getting a field goal in a game neither offense is expected to run away with.
games.title: Giants at Eagles: the home dog
games.verdict: LEAN: PHI +3 — on the board at +1.6% EV.
games.weather: No NWS watch or warning in Philadelphia; no weather factor expected

games.matchup: Green Bay Packers @ New England Patriots
games.take: The best number on the board lives here: New England -3 clears our bar at +3.0% EV, the biggest edge of the day, and the moneyline clears too at +1.0%. The market knows A.J. Brown is out for the Patriots (knee, ruled out Friday) and the number still beats fair. The lean is the Patriots laying the field goal at home in Foxborough.
games.title: Packers at Patriots: the best number on the board
games.verdict: LEAN: NE -3 — on the board at +3.0% EV, the day's biggest edge.
games.weather: No NWS watch or warning in Foxborough; no weather factor expected

games.title: Sunday Night Football: Bucs at Bears

games.take: The marquee NBA game of the night, and the injury report is the story: Luka Doncic is questionable for the Lakers with low back tightness, while Detroit is without Jalen Duren (hamstring) and Isaiah Joe (hip). The market has Detroit about right — no price clears our 0.75% bar — so this is a lean, not a board play. No true edge here, but the lean is Detroit: the better defense, at home, against a Lakers team that may be without its engine.
games.title: Lakers at Pistons: Doncic questionable
games.verdict: LEAN: DET -4.5 — no true edge at -189, but the lean is Detroit at home with Doncic questionable.

games.take: The biggest NBA spread of the day, and the market has it about right — no price clears our 0.75% bar, so this is a lean, not a board play. Joel Embiid is probable for Philadelphia, and the 76ers are laying 9.5 on the road in Chicago. No true edge here, but the lean is Philadelphia: the better team, the healthier star, and a Bulls side catching nearly double digits at home.
games.title: 76ers at Bulls: the big road number
games.verdict: LEAN: PHI -9.5 — no true edge at -382, but the lean is Philadelphia on the road.

games.take: The widest number on either slate: Boston is a 13.5-point favorite in Milwaukee, and the market has it about right — no price clears our 0.75% bar, so this is a lean, not a board play. The Bucks are 1-8 and neither team has a player on the injury report, so there is no late-news risk behind a spread this large. No true edge here, but the lean is Boston: the 7-2 Celtics against a 1-8 Bucks team.
games.title: Celtics at Bucks: the widest number of the day
games.verdict: LEAN: BOS -13.5 — no true edge at -695, but the lean is Boston against a 1-8 Milwaukee side.
